provider: NCI Genomic Data Commons / The Cancer Genome Atlas
retrieval_information: TCGA-LUAD data obtained through recount3; cohort resolution and biospecimen provenance are recorded in Tasks #001-#005.
dependency_notes: primary biological dataset underlying the recount3 TCGA-LUAD project used here; Tumour/normal imbalance, shared cases, technical replication, FFPE provenance, and batch/TSS structure are documented upstream.

retrieval_information: Programmatic recount3 retrieval with the gene annotation pinned to gencode_v26.
dependency_notes: derived from SRC_TCGA_LUAD; depends on recount3 processing semantics and pinned gencode_v26 annotation; This is a delivery/processing layer for TCGA expression, not an independent biological cohort.

source_name: Project primary DE and prespecified S1-S6 sensitivity analyses
retrieval_information: Frozen Task #006 primary DE and Task #007 sensitivity outputs integrated by Task #008/Task #012.
dependency_notes: derived from SRC_RECOUNT3_TCGA_LUAD and the same frozen final cohort; S0-S6 are related model views; Primary and sensitivity models provide robustness characterization, not multiple independent datasets.

retrieval_information: Official Open Targets Platform retrieval in Tasks #010-#011; exact request/response provenance is recorded in their session files.
dependency_notes: multi-source aggregator; may incorporate literature, genetics, ChEMBL, clinical precedence, and curated safety datasources; Task #010 and Task #011 use the same Platform data release 26.06/API 26.6.3; different fields are not automatically independent evidence.

retrieval_information: Official ChEMBL target retrieval in Task #010; only target annotations/availability are represented here.
dependency_notes: Task #010 stores target availability only; Open Targets tractability and drug records may reuse ChEMBL-derived information; Current ChEMBL target presence is not compound activity, potency, mechanism, or clinical actionability evidence.

retrieval_information: Local standard-library integration of frozen Tasks #008-#011; no new scientific observation was generated.
dependency_notes: derived from Tasks #008-#011; contains no new independent scientific observation; Integration improves auditability but does not increase evidence independence or confidence by itself.
